caption:
Aloo Capsicum Subzi
home food 101 | vegan recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 54 | F: 3 | P: 7
Calories: 257 per serving 
Serves 3

Ingredients:
1 tsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp cumin seeds
4 potatoes, cubed and parboiled 
1 capsicum, diced
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp salt
1/4 cup water
for garnish, coriander leaves

Method
add oil to a pan then the mustard and cumin seeds
stir together and then add in the parboiled diced potatoes
mix with the masalas, add a few tbsp of water and cover and allow to cook fully
(you dont need to parboil the potatoes but i cant cut them even to save my life so i prefer to parboil so i dont have any raw potatoes) 
add in the masalas and combine together 
add in the capsicum and mix it together fully
cook for a 1-2 minutes, add salt and top with fresh coriander
